question: Athletics Federation of India was formed in ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **1946**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Athletics Federation of India** (AFI) was formed in **1946**.
 
• It is the apex body for conducting and managing **athletics** events in India.
 
• AFI is affiliated with the **International Association of Athletics Federations (IAAF)**.
 
• The federation plays a crucial role in the **development and promotion of athletics** in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Entity
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Athletics Federation of India (AFI)
 The **governing body** for athletics in India, responsible for organizing national and international events.
 
 

 IAAF
 The **International Association of Athletics Federations**, now known as World Athletics, is the international governing body for the sport of athletics.
 
 

 National Championships
 AFI organizes **national championships** to identify and nurture talent in various athletic disciplines.
 
 

 Training Camps
 AFI conducts **training camps** for athletes to prepare them for international competitions.
 
 

 Development Programs
 AFI runs several **development programs** to promote athletics at the grassroots level across India.
